label: Kalshi (event contracts)
terms_note: Public market data only (no key): GET /markets and /markets/{ticker} carry no security requirement in https://docs.kalshi.com/openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.0, 82 operations). Cursor pagination (limit 1-1000, `cursor`). Spec vs live 2026-10-01: the `status` query enum is unopened|open|paused|closed|settled, but market records answer status "active" (not in the enum); the open filter works. Multivariate (parlay) markets dominate the open list, so mve_filter=exclude is sent. Unknown ticker: 404 {"error":{"code":"not_found"}}. Basic tier: 20 reads per second.

list_markets.note: Open, non-parlay markets (ticker, its event in `base`, binary/scalar in `type`; title and prices in raw). Pages by cursor only. Kalshi has no free-text search on this endpoint, so `query` is ignored.

get_ticker.note: Prices are the YES side in dollars (0-1); volume is contracts traded in 24h.

not_offered.me: Portfolio endpoints need an API key id and an RSA-PSS signature (KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY/SIGNATURE/TIMESTAMP); public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_candles: GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks requires the series ticker and a start_ts/end_ts window, which trading.get_candles does not take; not mapped rather than guessing a window.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /portfolio/balance needs a signed key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /portfolio/orders needs a signed key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /portfolio/orders needs a signed key and spends money; not mapped.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /portfolio/orders/{order_id} needs a signed key; not mapped.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
